minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  June 15, 2021

The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
on Tuesday, June 15, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint
Powers Authority at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority
Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Authority Members
  Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing
  Authority Member/ Joint Powers Authority Member
  Dotson.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority officials and
personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint Powers
Authority.
PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired
if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor
Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on the Agendas.
Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented on the Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 3,
Letter from the City Attorney’s Office returning a late claim, and 5, Amendment No. 1 to
Agreement No. 21-005 with HHJ Construction, Inc., to complete the residential sound
insulation work.

Caller (Name Unknown) commented on the Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 2,
Approval of the Minutes of the Meeting held on November 24, 2020, and H-SPH-1,
Setting of a public hearing to consider the Inglewood Housing Authority 1-Year (2021-
2022) Agency Plan and related certifications.

JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY MINUTES.  It was moved by Joint Powers
Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Joint Powers Authority Member Padilla
that the Minutes for the Joint Powers Authority Meeting held on November 24, 2020, be
approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Housing Authority Members Padilla, Morales, and Joint Powers Authority
  Chairman Butts;
Noes:  None;
Abstain: Joint Powers Authority Member Faulk; and
Absent: Joint Powers Authority Member Dotson.

There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts wished Marla Gibbs happy
birthday and adjourned the meeting at the hour of 2:27 p.m.

Approved this 28th day of September, 2021.
 June 15, 2021

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary
